name: pi-auto-approval
adaptations: Select only the reviewer prompt, JSON decision parser and context projection; omit the tool_call hook, /auto-approval command, config files, audit log, model selector, provider attribution and human-approval UI.

Molly calls the classifier only for auto-review escalations (unknown network domains, commands outside the OS sandbox, file access outside the workspace) through its own journaled session-model runtime.
State the sandbox context in the reviewer prompt; drop configurable allow/deny/environment guidance.
Project context from Pi session branch entries passed by the host; render image parts as [image].
Use repository formatting and single quotes.
activation: Embedded Pi auto-review permission mode only; a deny, failure or timeout falls back to the user's prompt.
